subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept these fourteen pinned GitHub Action revisions for workflows that handle GitHub App keys, publishing credentials, attestations, and OpenAI API keys?
rationale: The patch is a consistent dependency-pin refresh, but accepting updated external action code in privileged workflows is a repository security decision rather than a mechanical repair decision.

options.title: Accept after upstream pin review
options.body: Review the pinned upstream release diffs and merge after a current-head refresh confirms the affected workflows still run as intended.

options.title: Defer privileged action updates
options.body: Keep the PR open while splitting or deferring updates whose changed actions run with production secrets or publishing credentials.

recommendation.title: Accept after upstream pin review
recommendation.body: Review the pinned upstream release diffs and merge after a current-head refresh confirms the affected workflows still run as intended.
